texts.preamble: Deendayal Somani S/O Banshilal Somani ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 August, 2024 1 Mc In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Indore Before Hon'Ble Shri Justice Binod Kumar Dwivedi On The 9 th Of August, 2024 Misc. Criminal Case No. 53269 of 2021 Deendayal Somani S/O Banshilal Somani Proprietor Of M/S Shri Nakodasales Versus The State Of Madhya Pradesh
texts.facts: (iii) to quash the proceedings of criminal case No. (iv) to quash the impugned order of taking cognizance dated 18.11.2014 by JMFC, Jhabua in cr.case No. 1923/2014. 2. Counsel for the applicant submits that sample was taken by the 2 MCRC-53269-2021 Food Safety Officer on 14.09.2011. Sample was sent to Food Analyst on 15.09.2011. Report of the Public Analyst was received on 30.09.2011. Report of Referral Food Laborartory is dated 3.1.2012. The designated Officer has granted sanction on 7.12.2013 and complaint was filed before the trial court on 18.11.2014. Learned counsel inviting attention of this Court to the chronology as aforesaid, submits that complaint in the instant case has been filed on 18.11.2014 after more than 3 years from the date of alleged offence i.e. 14.9.2011.
texts.arguments: 4. To appreciate the controversy, it is apposite to refer section 77 of the Act which reads as under :- 3 MCRC-53269-2021 "Section 77. Time limit for prosecution :- Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, no court shall take cognizance of an offfence under this Act after the expiry of the period of one year from the date of commission of an offence: Provided that the Commissioner of Food Safety may, for reasons to be recorded in writing approve prosecution within an extended period up to three years." 5. The object of prescribing the period of limitation has been clarified by the Hon'ble appex court in the case State of Punjab vs Sarwan Singh, AIR 1981 SC 1054 wherein it is held that in putting a bar of limitation on prosecutions was clearly to prevent the parties from filing cases after a long time, as a result of which material evidence may disappear and also to prevent abuse of the process of the court by filing vexatious and belated prosecution long after the date of the offence.
